newsitem.title: USA: MethodistCare, General American form Texas alliance.
newsitem.headline: MethodistCare, General American form Texas alliance.

text.p: MethodistCare Inc, the health maintenance organization of Methodist Health Care System, said it has formed an alliance with St. Louis-based General American Life Insurance Co to provide services in southeast Texas.

The company said it will offer provider-based managed care in 44 counties, with coverage beginning January 1, 1997. Services will include home health, outpatient, pharmacy, ambulance and physical therapy.

General American will provide MethodistCare with marketing and sales, underwriting and administration services, while MethodistCare will provide medical management, provider relations and network development, the company said.
